static_traits.name: Su Kaiwen
static_traits.family_status: Parents recently moved to Florida, the elder brother currently lives temporarily in their home.
static_traits.social_status: Has friends to confide in, but not yet sharing feelings about the elder brother with them.
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychotherapy history; no similar problems before.
static_traits.language_features: Fairly cooperative, able to describe situations and thoughts concretely, cautious and slightly tense tone; clear expression, with self-Reflection.

basic_info.main_problem: Since my elder brother moved in with me a month ago, I have felt he dislikes my cooking and my cat. This belief makes me feel Anxious and affects our relationship.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize these unreasonable thoughts are affecting my mental health and my relationship with my brother, prompting me to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: After parents moved to Florida, the elder brother began staying at home about a month ago. Since then, Su Kaiwen often interpreted the brother's expressions and words (e.g. saying 'I am not hungry' after he cooked) as negative evaluation when cooking or being with the cat with the brother present, gradually forming the belief that 'the brother dislikes my cooking and cat'. This belief raised Anxiety and Relationship tension, and led to avoiding interaction with the brother to prevent conflict, while trying different dishes to seek improvement, but no relationship improvement yet.

core_beliefs: I am not accepted by others

special_situations.event: The elder brother saying 'not hungry' after he cooked, or seeming uninterested in food
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the other does not eat the food I make, it means he dislikes my cooking and even dislikes me as a person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying different dishes to Gaining recognition; reducing interaction with the brother to avoid conflict
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He dislikes the food I make; he is negating me

special_situations.event: When spending time with the cat while the elder brother is present, and the brother shows coldness or distance toward the cat
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If he does not like my cat, it means he hates everything about me and wants to get away from me quickly
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: In front of the elder brother, reduces interaction with the cat; avoids communicating with the brother
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He cannot wait to leave me because he dislikes my cat

special_situations.event: Observing the brother's unenthusiastic expression or tone when looking at the food he made
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If his expression is not appreciative, it means he always dislikes every dish I make
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly adjusting dishes and changing methods to try Gaining recognition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He has never liked anything I make

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and accepted by family (older brother)
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being negated, Being rejected and triggering bigger relationship conflict
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being negated and conflict by keeping distance and Avoids communication

object_relations.self_representation: A negated, tense and uneasy provider (taking on caregiving and cooking at home)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised or thinking about openly discussing one's feelings about cooking and the cat with one's older brother
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Anticipating the other person will get defensive or negate oneself, thus making the relationship worse (treating uncertain outcomes as inevitable)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use a gentle, Empathy tone; first validate their concerns and feelings, then use open-ended questions to Guidance distinguishing facts from speculation, inviting them to identify evidence and possible alternative Interpretations, avoiding direct confrontation.

manifestations: Worried about being disliked and rejected by the elder brother; avoids communication to prevent conflict
Living together at home yet emotionally distant, Relationship tension

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains behavioral impulses originally meant to be directed outward, turning them toward themselves or choosing self-Repression, i.e. turning outward energy back onto oneself.
manifestations: Wanting to communicate with the elder brother but choosing avoidance to prevent conflict
Not sharing troubles with friends, internalizing stress

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings or thoughts that are hard for oneself to accept to others.
manifestations: Attributes the worry of 'being disliked' to the elder brother's thoughts, believing the other dislikes their cooking and cat

positive_force: Willing to seek counseling with a positive attitude
Able to identify and name cognitive distortions, willing to do reality testing
Willing to try starting light topics with elder brother and gradually communicate
Has a certain level of social support (has friends to confide in)
negative_force: Mind reading and jumping-to-conclusions cognitive tendency
Behavioral pattern of avoiding communication to avoid conflict
Caring too much about others' evaluations leading to heightened Anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids communicating and interacting with the older brother (to avoid conflict)
antecedent: Since older brother moved in about a month ago
After cooking, older brother says he is 'not hungry' or seems not interested
With the elder brother present, interacts with the cat and senses his coldness toward it
target_behavior.core_reason: Mind-reading and overgeneralizing about older brother's attitude, worrying about being negated and rejected, triggering Anxiety and prompting avoidance
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential negative evaluation and relationship conflict, lowering Anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship further tenses and grows distant, misunderstandings deepen, Daily life affected, Increased anxiety
